'''Gnawer's Roost''' was a neighborhood in the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Gnawer's Roost was home to many criminals, and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had no law enforcement presence there. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Tavik Moern|Pavel Trenol]] fled there following his escape from [[Imeici Spire]], and a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] fighters went into the area to find him, eventually finding themselves in the [[Invisible Hand cantina]].
